root_cause.text: The function `aa_replace_profiles()` fails to clear the `ent->ns_name` pointer after transferring its ownership to the local variable `ns_name`, leading to a double free when both `aa_load_ent_free(ent)` and `kfree(ns_name)` are called.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff adds `ent->ns_name = NULL;` immediately after `ns_name = ent->ns_name;` in `security/apparmor/policy.c` to prevent the same memory address from being freed twice.
